const canSubmit =
  !busy &&
  !loading &&
  recovery.ready &&
  !pendingSubmission &&
  quote !== null &&
  !!project &&
  ready &&
  (!needsArtwork || !!artwork) &&
  (operation === 'transcribe' ? !!audioBase64 : !!prompt.trim()) &&
  !sizeFailure &&
  !optionsFailure &&
  !batchFailure &&
  (operation !== 'generate-image' ||
    (referencedCount <= referenceLimit && (!referencedCount || !!caps?.references.supported)));
